facts.fact: Communications and IT Minister Raafat Hindy said the state has connected government bodies through the Government Digital Transformer, allowing real-time, secure data exchange with more than 100 government databases.
Minister Hindy said 105 government bodies are connected through the Government Digital Transformer, with integration to more than 100 government databases.
